sections.text: Telemetry retention is 30 days. After retention expiry, the daily cleanup job removes expired telemetry records. Aggregated monthly counts remain available for 12 months. onyxindexedsearchfixture
A priority one incident pages the on-call engineer immediately. The incident coordinator records the timeline and posts a status update every 15 minutes. onyxindexedsearchfixture

An indexed knowledge service ingests documents before queries arrive. Background synchronization refreshes the index, while retrieval applies metadata and access filters. Poll search visibility after ingestion rather than assuming a database row proves retrieval readiness. onyxindexedsearchfixture
